What is VHF Omnidirectional Range?

In this glossary, VHF Omnidirectional Range refers to: Ground-based VHF radio beacon providing 360-degree azimuth guidance to aircraft.

How is VHF Omnidirectional Range used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Tower, Lufthansa 851, established on the Bremen VOR, requesting outbound clearance on radial 270 at 4000 feet."
